description: Curated UXP runtime notes that cannot be derived by rule from api.json. Mirrors the UXP toggle of https://www.indesignjs.de/indesignapi/. Rule-based notes (enum equals(), File/Folder async, [] accessor, File handler) live in parser.py.

properties.activeScript: In UXP this is only the path as a string - not a File object, and without its properties.
properties.scriptArgs: In UXP, read arguments from script.args instead of app.scriptArgs.getValue().

XMLElements.class: itemByName() does not work under UXP. Use evaluateXPathExpression() on the parent XMLElement instead.

methods.itemByName: Not available in UXP. Use evaluateXPathExpression() on the parent XMLElement instead.
